ProbiusEchoPulseDisruptionPulse.name: Echo Pulse
ProbiusEchoPulseDisruptionPulse.description: Disruption Pulse now returns to Probius 1.25 seconds after reaching its target, dealing 100% damage on the return trip.

ProbiusWarpResonanceWarpRiftQuest.name: Warp Resonance
ProbiusWarpResonanceWarpRiftQuest.description: Quest: Hit Heroes with Warp Rift explosions. Reward: After hitting 8 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, increase the explosion damage by 120. Reward: After hitting 16 Heroes with Warp Rift explosions, Warp Rift gains 1 additional charge.

ProbiusGatherMineralsPhotonCannonQuest.name: Gather Minerals
ProbiusGatherMineralsPhotonCannonQuest.description: Quest: Gather Minerals to increase the Health of Photon Cannons by 8, up to 560. Reward: After collecting 70 Minerals, Photon Cannons deal 35% more damage.

ProbiusPhotonBarrierPhotonCannon.name: Photon Barrier
ProbiusPhotonBarrierPhotonCannon.description: While a Photon Cannon is alive and powered, Probius gains 40 Spell Armor.

ProbiusTurboChargedWorkerRush.name: Turbo Charged
ProbiusTurboChargedWorkerRush.description: Worker Rush grants an additional 10% passive Movement Speed while in a Power Field, and its cooldown is reduced by 14 seconds.

ProbiusShieldCapacitor.name: Shield Capacitor
ProbiusShieldCapacitor.description: Probius gains permanent Shields equal to 10% of his max Health. Shields regenerate quickly as long as he hasn't taken damage recently.

ProbiusParticleAcceleratorDisruptionPuls.name: Particle Accelerator
ProbiusParticleAcceleratorDisruptionPuls.description: After hitting 3 Heroes with Disruption Pulse, the next Warp Rift detonated by a Disruption Pulse fires 4 additional pulses that deal 78 (+5% per level) damage from the impact location in different directions. Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

ProbiusRiftShockWarpRift.name: Rift Shock
ProbiusRiftShockWarpRift.description: Hitting a Warp Rift with Disruption Pulse within 1 second of it arming deals 105 (+5% per level) damage over 3 seconds.

ProbiusTowerDefensePhotonCannon.name: Tower Defense
ProbiusTowerDefensePhotonCannon.description: Reduce Photon Cannon's cooldown by 3.5 seconds when Disruption Pulse or Warp Rift damages an enemy Hero.

ProbiusPylonOverchargeHeroic.name: Pylon Overcharge
ProbiusPylonOverchargeHeroic.description: For 8 seconds, increase the size of Pylon power fields and allow them to attack enemy Heroes within it for 96 (+4% per level) damage per second. Pylons are Invulnerable for the duration.

ProbiusNullGateHeroic.name: Null Gate
ProbiusNullGateHeroic.description: Vector Targeting Project a barrier of negative energy in the target direction that lasts 4 seconds. Enemies who touch the barrier take 76 (+4% per level) damage per second and are Slowed by 80% for as long as they remain in contact with it.

ProbiusAggressiveMatrixWarpInPylon.name: Aggressive Matrix
ProbiusAggressiveMatrixWarpInPylon.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 35% increased Attack Damage.

ProbiusPowerOverflowingWarpInPylon.name: Power Overflowing
ProbiusPowerOverflowingWarpInPylon.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 10% increased Spell Power and 2 Mana per second.

ProbiusShieldBatteryWarpInPylon.name: Shield Battery
ProbiusShieldBatteryWarpInPylon.description: Pylon's Power Field grants allied Heroes 28 (+4% per level) Shields per second, up to 112 (+4% per level). Shields persist for 2 seconds after exiting a Pylon Power Field.

ProbiusQuantumEntanglementWarpRift.name: Quantum Entanglement
ProbiusQuantumEntanglementWarpRift.description: Enemies continue to be slowed for 3 seconds after their last contact with a Warp Rift.

ProbiusGravityWellWarpRift.name: Gravity Well
ProbiusGravityWellWarpRift.description: Enemies are slowed more the closer they are to the center of the Warp Rift, up to a maximum slow of 60%.

ProbiusInterferenceWarpRift.name: Interference
ProbiusInterferenceWarpRift.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Warp Rift explosions have their Spell Power reduced by 35% for 5 seconds. Additionally, enemies hit by Warp Rift explosions are knocked away from the center.

ProbiusConstructAdditionalPylonsPylonOve.name: Construct Additional Pylons
ProbiusConstructAdditionalPylonsPylonOve.description: Probius can now have up to 3 active Pylons, and increase the damage of Pylon Overcharge by 25%.

ProbiusGateKeeperNullGate.name: Gate Keeper
ProbiusGateKeeperNullGate.description: Null Gate lasts indefinitely if either end is within a Power Field.

ProbiusShootEmUptoRiftsDisruptionPulse.name: Shoot 'Em Up
ProbiusShootEmUptoRiftsDisruptionPulse.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Disruption Pulse take a bonus 2.5% of their maximum Health as damage. Passive: Reduce the cooldown of Disruption Pulse by 0.5 seconds.

ProbiusProbiusLoopWarpRift.name: Probius Loop
ProbiusProbiusLoopWarpRift.description: Whenever a Rift explosion hits 1 or more enemy Heroes, create a new Warp Rift in the same location.
